# Lab 23.12: Create an Aggregated Sink to BigQuery

## What We Are Going to Do
Route Admin Activity logs from every project in the organization into one BigQuery dataset in a central logging project.

## Steps

1. **Create the dataset** in your central logging project.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --dataset --location=US LOG_PROJECT_ID:org_audit</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create the aggregated sink at organization level.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud logging sinks create org-audit-to-bq \
  bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/LOG_PROJECT_ID/datasets/org_audit \
  --organization=ORG_ID \
  --include-children \
  --use-partitioned-tables \
  --log-filter='logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Give the sink permission to write.** Copy the writer identity, then grant it on the logging project.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud logging sinks describe org-audit-to-bq --organization=ORG_ID --format="value(writerIdentity)"

gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding LOG_PROJECT_ID \
  --member="WRITER_IDENTITY" \
  --role=roles/bigquery.dataEditor</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Make a change anywhere.** In any project, create and delete a firewall rule or a bucket.

5. **Query the central table.** After a few minutes, a table such as `cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity` appears.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '
SELECT timestamp, protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS who,
       protopayload_auditlog.methodName AS action, resource.labels.project_id
FROM `LOG_PROJECT_ID.org_audit.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity`
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud logging sinks delete org-audit-to-bq --organization=ORG_ID --quiet
bq rm -r -f --dataset LOG_PROJECT_ID:org_audit</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Coverage | Every project, including new ones |
| Destination | One dataset in the logging project |
| Writer identity | Must be granted access, or nothing arrives |
| Analysis | Standard SQL in BigQuery |
